name: mastra-server
//: Versions are pinned exactly, not with ^. `mastra build` writes a second package.json into .mastra/output and runs its own npm install there, which package-lock.json does not cover. With ranges, that install can pick a newer @mastra/* sub-package than the core it is built against, and the server fails to start. Bump these together.
//overrides: @mastra/loggers 1.3.0 imports buildLogRecordData from @mastra/core, which only exists in 1.63 pre-releases, so it fails against the current stable core 1.62.0. The mastra CLI depends on ^1.2.0 and would otherwise resolve to 1.3.0. Remove this override once @mastra/core 1.63.0 is stable.
